title: Friendly empty note
summary: With no finished games, the statistics slip shows a single sentence ('Zatím tu nic není. Dohrajte první tabuli…') and a dark 'Na dnešní tabuli' button that scrolls to the board and focuses the input; with history the slip is unchanged.
tradeoffs: The slip becomes much shorter than the column next to it on desktop; first-timers do not see what will be tracked.
